title: Every chest.
intro: Your matches, your milestones, your next treasure. All in one place.
noActivity: Your next match starts the story.
overlayHint: Add your counter as an OBS Browser Source. Size: 420 × 120.
noMatches: No matches yet. Open the companion and play a match with replay recording enabled.
baseHint: Set your current milestone for this profile. Future chests are added automatically. Clear to use replay totals.
folderHint: Windows companion required. Leave the default unless your replays are elsewhere.
roomHint: Enter the room from your companion overlay URL to view it on another device. Room links are public.
step1Body: In Fortnite: Settings → Game → Replays → Record Replays → On.
step2Body: Run NBFC TRACKER on Windows. It reads your saved replays and keeps profiles separate.
step3Body: Copy the overlay URL into an OBS Browser Source. Keep the companion running.
privacy: Reads local replay files. No game memory access. Not affiliated with Epic Games.
creator: Support with creator code
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
requiresDesktop: Open the Windows companion to change this setting.
invalidCount: Enter a whole number from 0 to 2,147,483,647.
invalidRoom: Enter a room name of 1–128 characters.
stale: Last saved snapshot · companion may be offline
updateAccess: GitHub access is required for this private release. Open the release page to download.
updateOffline: Could not reach the update server. Please try again.
updateRateLimited: GitHub is limiting requests. Please try again later.
updateMissing: The release download is not ready yet. Please try again shortly.
installFailed: The update could not be installed. Your current app is preserved. Please try again.
versionMismatch: Desktop {app} · Web {web}. Download the matching release.
historyNotice: The first count uses replays saved on this PC, often around 100 matches. It is not your full season or career total. Enter your known total or best estimate; new chests will count upward from it. Clear the starting count to use recorded replay totals.
overlayEditHint: Save settings here. OBS updates automatically using the same URL. Keep the companion and OBS on the same PC.
homeIntro: Automatic Fortnite chest counting from your replays. Your milestones, match history and OBS overlay, together.
localBody: Reads gameplay data from saved replay files. No game injection, game-memory access or game-file modification. No Epic login. Replay data stays on this PC.
verifyBody: Public source and SHA-256 checksums. This Windows app is unsigned: review security warnings and verify your download before running it.
autoBody: New chests count automatically. Saved overlay settings reach OBS through the same URL. Run OBS and the companion on the same PC.
connectionHelp: Install and open the Windows companion on this PC. If asked, allow this site to connect to local devices.
connectionAuto: Connecting automatically. This page opens when the companion is ready; no refresh needed.
runtimeHelp: The tracker is running. Microsoft WebView2 is unavailable, so use the browser dashboard or install the runtime and retry.
